title: Fine-Line Chinese Painted Scroll — An idea becomes a connected system (dawn mist)

scenes.title: Contours before pigment
scenes.purpose: Lay down a dawn-mist river valley in fine #3B544D contours that follow a line-weight hierarchy. Each translucent wash appears only after its contour group is complete.
visuals: Cool celadon silk #E1E8E4 with a stationary seeded Canvas 2D weave, inside a fixed warm-paper #D8C6A5 mount border
Rose #D2A6A3 dawn sun disk, its wash revealed after its 0.6px contour
Far range in mountain #B5CEC0 wash (1.3px contour, 0.6px ridge strokes), overlapped by the jade #86B6A2 mid range
Mist band in mist white #F2F5F0, revealed after its fine edge line
Ornamental cloud curls with billowed lobes, inner spirals and curling mist tails
Three pavilions with jade roofs and warm-paper platforms on the ridge
One scholar figure holding up a blossom sprig; plum branch with five rose blossoms; jade water ripples
Rose thread drawn from the held blossom to pavilions 1, 2 and 3, with a knot appearing as each span arrives

beats.development: The frame rule, sun, far range, plum branch, mid range, water lines and near bank draw in sequence. Each wash fades in after its own contour group. The titles rise in as standalone headings.

The mist band, clouds, pavilions, figure and blossoms finish drawing, then fill. 念 appears after the seal frame closes, and the caption fades in. The rose thread links the blossom to the three pavilions.
captions: one blossom, a thread, three pavilions

scenes.title: The scroll breathes, then holds
scenes.purpose: Add restrained life to the finished painting, then settle so the whole composition can be read.
visuals: Bird flying along an authored arc
Four petals drifting down onto the water
Sleeve swaying about the shoulder pivot
Cloud band shifting 16px (about 1.25%); small cloud drifting 10px the other way

beats.development: The bird flaps along its path while the petals fall and settle. The sleeve sways 5° and returns to rest, and the cloud band makes a shallow lateral shift. The silk and weave stay fixed.

captions: one blossom, a thread, three pavilions

findings: All contours and washes are complete by 1.3s.
All motion ends by 2.6s, so the frame is settled before 2.7s.
The large mountain and mist wash reveals provide the main pixel change; the background never moves.

notes: Refresh: the background is now a scene-dependent dawn-mist celadon silk (#E1E8E4) instead of the warm #F0EEDD swatch, and a rose dawn sun and a mist band have been added.
